design.scenario_rule: Every required scenario must independently satisfy the frozen acceptance rule; no cross-scenario averaging.
design.invalid_attempt_rule: Any invalid outer attempt or unresolved requested-surrogate shortfall fails the scenario. Preserve every attempt and its reason. The empirical rejection rate uses requested N as its denominator; invalidity remains an independent hard failure.

required_gates_before_freeze: resume and checkpoint identity tests pass
connected and sharded per-index scientific outputs match exactly
merge rejects overlapping ranges, duplicate indices, missing indices, identity mismatch, and invalid or missing SHA-256 manifests
invalid attempts preserve the requested denominator and force scenario failure
protocol, code, dependency-lock, and workflow hashes are recorded
independent reviewer approves the exact candidate commit and hash manifest
scope_limit: Synthetic Type-I calibration is a specified parametric operating-characteristic diagnostic. It does not establish real-domain replication, universal stochastic-null adequacy, or HCM claim support.
